name: PaintMan Go！
detailed_description:
PaintMan GO! The main gameplay is TPS (Third-Person Shooting), where players control their characters and shoot to defeat other players. The game also incorporates the concept of ink, where players' ammo, health, and victory conditions are all related to ink. Players must consume their ammo to turn it into ink beans, which they can then use to absorb ink from the same colored dye areas to replenish their ammo.

In the same colored shadowed areas, life points will be restored, while in other colored shadowed areas, life points will gradually decrease. In normal mode, the winning and losing conditions are closely related to the shadowed areas. In short, taking many kills does not determine the outcome of the game, the size of the shadowed areas is the main criterion for determining the winner.

There are diverse and varied game maps in the game, each with a different playstyle. There are also various stylish game interface designs, allowing you to experience a cool and exciting battle. You can also choose from a variety of weapons in the changing weapon arsenal, and dress in cool and stylish outfits to stand out in the game!

Game Features

1. Cool and beautiful girls for you to choose and customize in the graffiti world;

2. Innovative Battle Royale, multiplayer real-time combat tournament;

3. A wide variety of weapons at your disposal, with endless strategies to discover!

4. The squid undergoes a colorful transformation, making it a fun and fascinating experience.

5. Shoot to be just, and spray the world at your command.

short_description: "PaintMan GO!" is a Q-version 3D style TPS game with a hip-hop theme. Players will take on the role of a spray painter, choosing from various ink weapons to compete in a city of graffiti, creating a brand new and alternative shooting experience through freestyle graffiti.
